item.title: Portuguese explorers along the African coast
item.description: "[A]ttention is paid to the run-up to the voyages of discovery, and what events and views formed the basis and led to the flourishing of the Portuguese maritime industry [...]. The discovery of a sea route around the southern tip of Africa to India did not happen all at once, but was preceded by a series of events that flowed together into a fascinating story that began in the Middle Ages with the founding of the Order of the Templars."
